The **Collections** standard library works with lists and dictionaries: build
them, search them, and read values out. You met `Create List` and
`Length Should Be` in Part 1; here are the everyday operations —
`List Should Contain Value`, `Create Dictionary`, `Dictionary Should Contain Key`,
and `Get From Dictionary`.

## Task 1 — Work with lists and dictionaries

**Goal:** create `checks/collections.robot` that builds a list and a dictionary,
checks their contents, and reads a value out of the dictionary.

Here is the same set of operations over different values. Adapt them.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Build A List And A Dict
    ${colors}=    Create List    red    green    blue
    Length Should Be    ${colors}    3
    List Should Contain Value    ${colors}    green
    ${stock}=    Create Dictionary    red=5    blue=2
    Dictionary Should Contain Key    ${stock}    blue
    ${n}=    Get From Dictionary    ${stock}    red
    Should Be Equal As Integers    ${n}    5
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the suite imports `Collections` and defines `Work With Lists And Dicts`.

<!-- hint -->
Build a four-item list with `Create List    backpack    lamp    mug    notebook`,
then `Length Should Be    ${products}    4` and
`List Should Contain Value    ${products}    mug`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Build a dict with `Create Dictionary    backpack=79    lamp=34`, check a key with
`Dictionary Should Contain Key`, and read one with
`Get From Dictionary    ${prices}    backpack`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Work With Lists And Dicts
    ${products}=    Create List    backpack    lamp    mug    notebook
    Length Should Be    ${products}    4
    List Should Contain Value    ${products}    mug
    ${prices}=    Create Dictionary    backpack=79    lamp=34
    Dictionary Should Contain Key    ${prices}    lamp
    ${value}=    Get From Dictionary    ${prices}    backpack
    Should Be Equal As Integers    ${value}    79
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it green

Run:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the list and dictionary operations all hold.
